# Decorative prop d10075: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10075/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully repaint the binding original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the short reddish handle, silver cap, curved chain, and ornate bright weight built around a round central orb with opposing crescent-wing flat metal piece and smaller part. Render one complete Imperial Star on genuine transparent RGBA. CORRECTION (overrides the notes above): the handle is far too thick. Make it a SLIM rod like the tool head in the style reference and like MM6-MM8 tool head: its width is only about 1/18 of the item's total height (a paperdoll fist must close around it), the same width from the grip to the chain ring. Keep its colours, rings and wrapping, and keep the chain and the striking head exactly as designed; only the handle becomes thinner..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: A harmless static decorative prop for a cosy fantasy game, texture sheet only. Faithfully repaint the binding original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the short reddish handle, silver cap, curved chain, and ornate bright weight built around a round central orb with opposing crescent-wing flat metal piece and smaller part. Render one complete Imperial Star on genuine transparent RGBA. CORRECTION (overrides the notes above): the handle is far too thick. Make it a SLIM rod like the tool head in the style reference and like MM6-MM8 tool head: its width is only about 1/18 of the item's total height (a paperdoll fist must close around it), the same width from the grip to the chain ring. Keep its colours, rings and wrapping, and keep the chain and the striking head exactly as designed; only the handle becomes thinner.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10075/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

Input order: Image 1 is paint_mask_guide.png, the edit target and exact layout/silhouette authority. Image 2 is design_reference.png, material/detail reference only. Image 3 is icon_x8.png, colour reference only. Preserve the guide geometry and its foreshortened orthographic views; do not replace them with the reference silhouette. Output the full 3-column 4-row sheet, not a single item.
